correctness.rationale: Replayed inputs/artifacts/verify.py: VERIFY_OK for all odd p<=61 every h!=0, worst |C|/sqrt(p)=2.638666 at (53,35), matching DRAFT. Proof checked step-by-step: F_a=[x a]*Kl2 tensor L_chi rank 2 pure weight 0 geometrically irreducible lisse on G_m (Katz Thm 4.1.2 + Kummer), Swan_infty=1 slopes 1/2, tame nontrivial at 0. For h!=0 on U=A1\{0,-h}, G=F tensor F_h^vee rank 4: H^0_c=0 (affine curve), H^2_c=0 because F ramified tame-nontrivial at 0 while F_h lisse at 0, so no geometric F->F_h map; irreducibility preserved under dense-open restriction and translation, so Schur applies. Trace formula gives C(h)=-Tr(Frob|H^1_c) since point contributions at 0,-h vanish by K_a(0)=0. Euler-Poincare: chi_c(U)=-1, Swan_0=Swan_{-h}=0 by tameness (one factor lisse, other tame), so dim H^1_c=4+Swan_infty(G). Each factor has breaks <=1/2, tensor breaks <=max, so Swan_infty(G)<=4*1/2=2 (DRAFT writes <=8 via 4*1/2=8 arithmetic slip, still valid as loose upper bound). Hence dim<=6 (hence <=12) and Weil II gives |C(h)|<=6 sqrt(p) <=12 sqrt(p) uniformly, B empty. Omitted explicit tame-vanishing and restriction-irreducibility justifications are standard and fillable; arithmetic slip does not invalidate claimed 12, in fact strengthens to 6. Relies on Deligne Weil II/Katz/Euler-Poincare as cited black boxes, which is permitted. Headline Burgess p^-0.004 gain explicitly NOT claimed, honestly limited.
